content:
Apple yesterday released the all-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 lineup, along with the new AirPods 5. They will officially go on sale next Friday, September 18.

Before they hit stores, Apple's new products are already available for pre-order on Amazon.

AirPods 5

First, Apple's new AirPods 5 offer more features at a lower price. For example, both AirPods 5 models now come with active noise cancellation, which was not the case with the previous-generation AirPods 4. However, there are some differences between the two — the lower-tier model lacks on-stem volume controls and a wireless charging case. The higher-tier model also gets roughly an extra hour of battery life.

I've been using the AirPods 5 for a few hours, and I've been really impressed by the ANC improvements. I'll have a more detailed write-up soon.

Apple Watch Series 12

On another note, the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 see major improvements in health tracking. Apple is calling it an all-new Health Sensing System, which enables higher-frequency heart rate and HRV detection, powering a new readiness score feature. It also adds new Audio Intelligence features, including Live Rewind and Siri Recap.

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm $399
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm $449
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm GPS + Cell $490 (originally $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm GPS + Cell $549
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium $699
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Titanium $729 (originally $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic $949

New Apple Watch Band Colors

Finally, Amazon also has several of the new Apple Watch bands available. I've briefly tried the new colors, and I'm particularly fond of the new translucent Ocean Band option.

  • All-new Trail Loop $99 in Sand, Dark Umber, Burgundy
  • All-new Ocean Band $99 in Translucent Kelp, Gray, and Black
  • All-new Alpine Loop $99 in Desert, Dark Olive, and Burgundy

Are you planning to order the new Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, or AirPods 5? Let us know in the comments.
